accuracy_notes: Photo-informed original artwork: Paracanthurus hepatus visual study. Animated tail and fins; not a scanned specimen or taxonomic identification model. Original Paracanthurus hepatus visual study based on the inspected Mark Rosenstein photograph. The supplied generic Surgeonfish/Tang alias is retained; the two peduncle scalpels are represented folded. Fine dentition and microscopic scale detail are simplified and swimming is artist-tuned.
